scope_note: This is a prospectively specified exploratory analysis of pre-existing frozen source ledgers plus one newly executed cached-model baseline. It is not prospective data collection and does not modify W6 canonical-v2 primary gates.

inspected_before_freeze: local model-cache presence, snapshot references, sizes, and hashes

planned_arms_in_display_order.definition: full trained head and mixture with local channel removed at inference
role score and its floor removed at inference; retained query/local weights are used and result min-max normalized

modern_baseline.tie_rule: stable descending score then original sentence order
modern_baseline.runtime_boundary: model load plus scoring and top-K extraction over the complete test partition; report wall time and peak RSS

planned_single_multiplicity_family.point_estimate: mean claim-level paired F1 difference; average the five source-seed values per claim before deterministic contrasts
planned_single_multiplicity_family.uncertainty: 10000-draw paired document-cluster percentile bootstrap with replacement, all claims retained in each sampled document, RNG seed 20260805 plus contrast index
planned_single_multiplicity_family.raw_p: two-sided bootstrap sign probability, twice the smaller tail proportion, capped at one
planned_single_multiplicity_family.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across all 11 frozen contrasts
planned_single_multiplicity_family.exploratory_positive_flag: mean > 0, percentile CI lower bound > 0, and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05
planned_single_multiplicity_family.secondary_cutoffs: K=1,5,10 are descriptive only and cannot create or rescue an exploratory positive flag

reporting_contract: Report every planned arm at every planned cutoff regardless of result.
Report all 11 planned K=3 contrasts with raw and Holm-adjusted p-values and bootstrap intervals.
Label source-mode comparisons as prospectively specified extraction from pre-existing ledgers, not prospectively collected experiments.
Do not alter, merge with, or reinterpret W6 canonical-v2 role/BM25 gates.
Report modern-baseline runtime under its exact boundary; do not call non-comparable historical full-script times a Pareto frontier.
